name: ES Midday Inventory Reload v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
role: Supplemental afternoon engine; not frequency-compliant as a standalone strategy
hypothesis: A two-hour lunch move that opposes but does not erase the preceding two-hour morning move represents an incomplete inventory correction. The original morning side should tend to reload into the closing session.

rules.long_signal: morning leg is positive, lunch leg is negative, and 13:29 close remains above the 09:30 open
rules.short_signal: morning leg is negative, lunch leg is positive, and 13:29 close remains below the 09:30 open
rules.entry: 13:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
rules.stop: 09:30 cash-session open plus one adverse ES tick
rules.same_bar_rule: a stop touched anywhere in a one-minute bar is filled at the frozen stop price
rules.survivor_exit: 15:55 open plus one adverse ES tick
rules.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

economics.slippage_model: one adverse tick at entry; one adverse tick at the time exit; stop itself is placed one adverse tick beyond the cash-session open

failed_frequency_extension.description: Adding a 60-minute morning leg and 60-minute correction slot at 11:30 raised total frequency to 2.71 trades per week but lost $1329.22 in that added slot and made 2021 negative.
failed_frequency_extension.decision: The early slot is rejected and prohibited from the frozen engine.

verdict: The pristine holdout is positive in aggregate and the engine has low daily correlation with the opening portfolio, but 2024 and longs fail while uncertainty remains high. Preserve only as a one-MES supplemental paper engine with no side or year filters. It is not a validated standalone strategy.
